## Description

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an identified defect)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking addition of a command or capability)
- [ ] New reference domain skill (in `generated-skills/`)
- [ ] Platform compatibility enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update or beginner guide improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code uses **Python standard library only** (zero third-party dependencies).
- [ ] I have run the complete unit test suite (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`).
- [ ] I have verified cross-platform compatibility (macOS, Linux, Windows).
- [ ] Any new skills pass validation (`skillfactory validate`) and score Grade A (`skillfactory eval`).
- [ ] Security scanners have run cleanly with zero critical/high findings (`skillfactory scan`).
- [ ] No personal tokens, API keys, or private files are included.
